_comment: Scan identity vectors authored by the extension (architecture review 2026-10-26, High 3). `key` is what the scan is filed under (cloud/scan-identity.ts normalizeScanUrl: fragment dropped, one trailing slash dropped except the root); `id` is scanIdFor(key). `rawId` is scanIdFor(input), what the app's bulk-audit.ts and monitor-rescan.ts compute today: wherever it differs from `id`, the same page lands in two cloud documents. See docs/contract/README.md.
